title: Filter syntax probe: high-priority, not-done tasks due soon
description: Ergonomics probe for the Vikunja filter query language (docs/API_NOTES.md's 'Filter Implementation Notes'): sets up mixed data, then asks the agent to narrow it down with a filter expression rather than fetching everything and filtering client-side. RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning unchanged -- create-project (1) + bulk-create 6 tasks, each carrying its own `priority`/`dueDate` in the same bulk-create call (1) + a single vikunja_tasks list call with a filter expression (1) = 3. Neither PR #178 nor PR #175 changes this: there is no label or Kanban dimension, and the filter-query step is a read operation setup-kanban cannot replace.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Filter Probe" with 6 tasks: three called "{{prefix}}urgent-N" (N=1..3) with priority 5, due in 3 days, and three called "{{prefix}}later-N" (N=1..3) with priority 1, due in 60 days. Then use a filter query (not manual inspection) to find just the not-done tasks with priority 4 or higher, due within the next 14 days, and tell me their titles.
